thread:
david-cs: Escalation from Acme (INC-4721). They received a legal notice asking for timeline + scope on audit log exports. Customer reports export failed (~02:35 UTC) and subsequent API attempts returned 403 after a KMS rotation. Need SRE + Security + Legal to triage.

aisha-oncall: Oncall here, pinging infra. Did they trigger export via Console or API? Any repro steps we can run quickly?

david-cs: Console > Settings > Export audit logs -> CSV export failed with 500. They retried via API and initially got 500, then 403 on later attempts. Provided correlation IDs: 0b7a1f4c, 3c9f2b88.

ben-infra: Looking at infra logs. We had an automated KMS rotation at 02:12 UTC. Audit-export service restarted around 02:28 UTC. Logs show decrypt/access errors -> 500s until alias reconciliation at ~03:05 UTC. Quick snippet:

```
[02:11:58] kms-service: rotate key alias: alias/audit-export -> alias/audit-export-v2
[02:28:14] audit-export: decrypt error: AccessDeniedException (key not found)
[02:34:02] audit-export: export request id=0b7a1f4c status=500 stack=... 
[03:05:12] ops: reconciled alias, restart exporter, exports resumed
```

ben-infra: Early hypothesis: rotation briefly left alias unattached or exporter cached old key id -> transient failures and then 403 once key policy changed. No evidence of data deletion.

cora-security: Scope question: which customers got impacted beyond Acme? Any indication of logs being readable or exfiltrated? We need to confirm affected tenant list and whether PII could have been exposed.

ben-infra: Affected tenants we saw retrying: Acme (explicit), BetaCo, and a handful of internal test tenants. Requests were failing; we did not see successful exports for those tenants during the window. Objects in S3 remained encrypted and untouched.

ellie-legal: Legal: provide exact timestamps for events, full list of impacted tenants, and whether any data was deleted or exported to a third party. If no exfil, note that in the draft. Recommend proactive customer notification — they asked for timeline. We'll need signoff from Security.

aisha-oncall: Can we get correlation IDs for other tenants and the exact KMS key IDs referenced? Also need the runbook steps taken so we can produce the incident timeline.

ben-infra: Other correlation IDs: 3c9f2b88 (BetaCo), 7e2a6d11 (int-test). KMS key IDs: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-1234 -> rotated to key/efgh-5678. Root cause: rotation script detaches alias before re-attaching to new key for ~2m in a few cases. I've pushed a fix and a PR to change to attach-before-detach (PR #891).

sre-incident-bot: Incident created: INC-4721: audit-export-access-failure -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4721

eng-ops-bot: Deploy: added additional retry + alerting for audit-export consumer at 03:30 UTC. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/audit-export-kms-rotation

david-cs: Customer asks explicitly: (1) Did we delete any logs? (2) Was any data accessible outside their org? (3) What did we do to fix it and prevent recurrence? I'll draft a response once we have confirm.

ben-infra: Confirming: no deletions, S3 objects are intact and still encrypted. Access logs show service principal calls only (no external principals). The 403s were due to key policy mismatch during rotation. Fix timeline: rotation at 02:12, exporter restart/retries 02:28-03:05, alias reconciliation and successful exports 03:05. I'll attach stack traces to the RCA.

ellie-legal: Draft template for customer notification: short timeline + statement that we found no evidence of exfil or deletion, explanation of root cause (KMS alias gap), and remediation steps + commitment to follow-up with RCA within 72 hours. We should aim to send within 24 hours. I will prepare the language and share.

cora-security: Security review: verified access logs and key usage logs — only internal service principals attempted decrypts; no external reads. We'll sign off on no data leak. We'll also request post-rotation KMS monitoring alert for abnormal decrypt failures.

aisha-oncall: Action items: Ben - finalize RCA + PR to rotation script; Cora - confirm logs and prepare sign-off; Ellie - customer notification draft; Aisha - incident timeline + postmortem. Target dates: PR merged within 48h, notification within 24h, postmortem within 3 business days.

david-cs: I'll send the initial notification to Acme once Ellie gives language. CC: support, legal, security. Thanks everyone.

ellie-legal: I'll have a review-ready draft in ~2 hours.

ben-infra: Filed PR #891, added attach-before-detach + healthcheck + alert. Will run a canary rotation tomorrow at 01:00 UTC under monitoring.

david-cs: Thanks. Closing thread for live triage — will reopen if customer escalates further.
